components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main action button for submit, save, approve, and create flows.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 40px; padding: 10px 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: #2563eb; color: #ffffff; font: 500 14px/1.4 Geist, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #1d4ed8; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2563eb; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: #1e40af; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.6; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Quiet action for cancel, clear filters, and low-risk secondary tasks.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 40px; padding: 10px 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: #f3f4f6; color: #374151; font: 500 14px/1.4 Geist, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #e5e7eb; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2563eb; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-secondary:disabled { opacity: 0.6; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Default form field for login, filters, modal edits, and data entry.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; font-family: Geist, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; } .ds-label { color: #374151; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.4; } .ds-input { min-height: 42px; width: 100%; border: 1px solid #d1d5db; border-radius: 8px; background: #ffffff; color: #111827; padding: 10px 12px; font: 400 14px/1.4 Geist, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; transition: border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #4b5563; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #2563eb; outline: 0; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.24); } .ds-input:disabled { background: #f3f4f6; color: #6b7280; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Pill badge for booking, vehicle, role, and maintenance status.
components.css: .ds-status-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 24px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #dcfce7; color: #166534; padding: 4px 10px; font: 600 12px/1.3 Geist, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; }

components.html:
จัดการรถ

narrative.northStar: ศูนย์ควบคุมที่เรียบและเชื่อถือได้
narrative.overview:
This design system serves an internal operations tool, so the interface must feel fast, clear, and dependable before it feels decorative. The visual language is a restrained product UI: white and gray working surfaces, a blue primary action color, Thai labels with direct wording, and consistent controls that keep users in the task.

The atmosphere is clean, quick, and easy to use. Screens should look like a reliable control center for bookings, approvals, vehicle records, and permissions. The system explicitly rejects flashy SaaS dashboard styling, overly playful consumer UI, heavy dark-mode aesthetics, cluttered admin panels, excessive gradients, and decorative motion.
keyCharacteristics: Restrained blue primary color for actions, focus, selection, and key navigation.
White surfaces on gray page backgrounds for calm operational contrast.
Lifted hierarchy for cards, tables, and modals, but never heavy decorative shadows.
Compact Thai-language typography with clear labels and dense data where needed.
State colors that map directly to operational meaning: success, warning, danger, info, maintenance.

rules.name: The Restrained Accent Rule
rules.body: Blue is for action and orientation, not decoration. Keep primary blue under 10% of a typical operations screen.

rules.name: The Status Means Status Rule
rules.body: Green, yellow, red, indigo, teal, and orange are reserved for semantic state. Do not use them as random card colors.

rules.name: The Thai Readability Rule
rules.body: Thai labels must stay at 14px or larger in interactive UI. Do not shrink operational copy to make dense screens look lighter.

rules.name: The No Display Labels Rule
rules.body: Buttons, tabs, filters, and table headers never use display styling. Product controls stay plain and readable.

rules.name: The Lifted But Official Rule
rules.body: Shadows may clarify depth, but they must never become atmospheric glow, glassmorphism, or dramatic spotlighting.

dos: Do use white cards and tables on gray page backgrounds to create calm operational structure.
Do reserve Control Blue for primary actions, current selection, and focus states.
Do use lifted shadows to clarify card, table, and modal hierarchy.
Do keep Thai labels direct and readable at 14px or larger.
Do pair every status color with text such as "รออนุมัติ", "อนุมัติแล้ว", "ปฏิเสธ", or "ซ่อมบำรุง".
Do keep buttons, inputs, badges, tables, and modals visually consistent across admin, approver, and user surfaces.
donts: Don't use flashy SaaS dashboard styling.
Don't use overly playful consumer UI.
Don't use heavy dark-mode aesthetics for the default experience.
Don't add decorative motion that does not communicate state.
Don't make role-based actions look like marketing feature cards when users need direct operational navigation.
Don't use green, yellow, red, indigo, teal, or orange as arbitrary decoration; they are status colors.
